classNameHelp: Java entity class name in PascalCase, for example SysPost
frontendTypeHelp: The Vben template follows this application's page conventions. Copy the vben folder of the download into apps/web-antd/src
confirmSync: Sync the columns of "{name}" from the database?
syncHelp: Added and removed columns are synced. Configured query types, dictionaries and display types are kept
deleteHelp: Only the generation configuration is deleted. The database table is not affected
confirmBatchDelete: Delete the {count} selected configurations? Database tables are not affected
editDescription: Configure how each column is used and how code is generated, then preview or download the code from the list
columnsHelp: Choose whether each column appears in create, edit, list and search, and whether it is required. Only select, radio, checkbox and switch can use a dictionary
javaFieldRequired: The Java field of column "{name}" is required
dictNotApplicable: Not used for this display type
packageNameHelp: Java package of the generated code, for example org.tuoyu.system
moduleNameHelp: First segment of the API path and permission code, for example system
businessNameHelp: Second segment of the API path and permission code, for example post
functionNameHelp: Used in the menu name, page title and code comments, for example Post
parentMenuHelp: The generated menu SQL places the new menu here
enableExportHelp: Generate the Excel export API and button
enableStatusHelp: Show the status column as a switch and generate the change-status API
statusFieldRequired: Select the status column for the status switch
enableUniqueHelp: Check that the combination of the selected columns is unique before saving
uniqueFieldsRequired: Select at least one column for the unique check
treeCodeHelp: ID of the node, for example dept_id
treeCodeRequired: Select the node ID column for a tree table
treeParentCodeHelp: ID of the parent node, for example parent_id
treeParentCodeRequired: Select the parent ID column for a tree table
treeNameHelp: Name shown for the node, for example dept_name
treeNameRequired: Select the node name column for a tree table
treeRootValueHelp: Parent ID of top-level nodes. Defaults to 0
treeAncestorsHelp: Optional column that stores the ancestor path, for example ancestors
treeOrderFieldHelp: Optional sort column among siblings, for example order_num
